description: NaCSbO₂F₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-70°. The Na-O bond length is 2.53 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-70°. The Na-O bond length is 2.52 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one O and three F atoms. The Sb-O bond length is 2.37 Å. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two O and three F atoms. There is one shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.67 Å) Sb-O bond length. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one C, and one Sb atom. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom.
